independent.summary: The test claims it hands `unansweredSweepFilter` an empty id list, but it sets `conversationRetentionDays: 0` on every entity, so `runRetentionSweepTick` returns at the `Entity.find({conversationRetentionDays:{$gt:0}})` guard and the filter builder is never reached — the real case (an entity due for sweep whose cutoff matches nothing, so `doomed` is empty) has no DB coverage.

The two deletes are sequential and non-transactional with the transcript going first: if `UnansweredQuestion.deleteMany` throws, the route returns 500 and the widget tells the visitor "nothing has been deleted yet — our conversation is still here on both sides" (widget/chatbot.js:718) when the transcript is already gone; self-healing on retry, but the reassurance is false in that window.
